main.title: COP31 Talks Collapse in Turkey in a Clash Over Fossil Fuels

180049a42e.topic: COP31 di Antalya fallisce, scontro UE-Arabia Saudita sui combustibili fossili
180049a42e.reason: Il vertice sul clima si chiude senza accordo: l'UE guida il fronte che respinge il testo finale, contro i Paesi produttori di petrolio. La notizia è ripresa da quasi tutte le grandi testate e tocca direttamente l'Europa e la sua politica energetica.

main.title: Russian warship hit by suspected Ukrainian drone at Benghazi naval base, Libyan officials say
main.summary: A Russian navy corvette docked at the Benghazi naval base ​in eastern Libya was hit on Sunday by a suspected Ukrainian sea drone, according to local officials. The strike severely damaged the warship and ignited a fire at the facility in what appeared to be the latest attack in Libya linked to the Russia-Ukraine war.

related.title: Russian ship hit in Benghazi by suspected Ukrainian drone attack, say Libyan officials
related.summary: No one has claimed responsibility for the strike on the vessel, which had docked on its way back to Russia A suspected Ukrainian drone attack caused an explosion on a Russian warship docked at the naval base in the Libyan port city of Benghazi, Libyan officials have said. The strike severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy warship, and ignited a fire at the naval base, they said. 210141b0f6.topic: Nave da guerra russa colpita a Bengasi (Libia), sospetto drone ucraino
210141b0f6.reason: Ne parlano molte testate autorevoli. Secondo funzionari locali, un sospetto drone ucraino ha colpito una corvetta russa a Bengasi: la guerra arriverebbe così nel Mediterraneo, a poca distanza dall'Italia, con conseguenze dirette sulla nostra sicurezza.
